purpose: Phase-7A microenvironment prediction records. Each documents a labelled prediction: relative ECM restriction / hypoxia influence / penetration reduction / oxygen limitation - never a fabricated oxygen concentration, ECM fibre density, collagen mass, interstitial pressure, absolute diffusion coefficient, or penetration rate.

pred_me_b16bl6.claim: The passive B16BL6 melanoma environment (moderately dense, hyaluronic-acid-rich ECM, restrictive interstitium, moderate hypoxia) reduces effective drug penetration relative to an unrestricted environment.
pred_me_b16bl6.rationale: General solid-tumour ECM + hypoxia biology restricts nanoparticle transport; applied predictively to this context (no direct dataset).
pred_me_b16bl6.uncertainty: Relative restriction only; all quantities NOT_REPORTED.
pred_me_b16bl6.limitations: Not a measured TME; schematic ordinal.

pred_me_human.claim: The predicted passive human skin environment (collagen-rich dermis, highly restrictive interstitium, mild hypoxia) reduces effective drug penetration - exploratory only.
pred_me_human.rationale: Human dermis collagen density is literature-known; applied predictively with distinct values (not copied from mouse).
pred_me_human.limitations: Exploratory; not shown by default; not validated for human clinical response.
